_comment: The metadata Nuvio would hand a provider, written down so `test/run.js --contract` can
exercise the whole getStreams path without a TMDB key.  These are the *inputs* a check is
run with, not expectations - nothing here is asserted about the sites.
When TMDB_API_KEY is set, run.js asks TMDB for the same ids and reports any entry whose
name or year has drifted, so this file cannot quietly go stale.
